blocks.text: TEHRAN, Iran — Bahrain accused Iran of striking a civilian industrial facility on Saturday, causing a fire and damage but no casualties, while two tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz, at the center of the Middle East conflict. The Gulf kingdom has suffered several attacks this week, ending a weeks-long lull in the conflict that began with US-Israeli strikes on Iran in late February. “As a result of the heinous Iranian aggression, a civilian industrial facility was targeted, causing a fire at the site.
